acceptance_criteria: The totals render exactly as returned, never summed. Verify: `tests/overview.test.tsx` renders the default fixture and finds dt/dd pairs "IN PROGRESS"/18, "NEED A PERSON"/5, "STOPPED"/3 and "VERIFIED THIS MONTH"/28, although the station counts sum to a different number. A second fixture with totals `{0,0,0,0}` but non-zero stations shows four 0s.

Every returned line and station is shown in order, with an exact count. Verify: in the component test, the "Lines" section has 8 `<li>` rows in fixture order. Each `<ol aria-label="<line> stations">` has as many items as the fixture's stations, and each item's text includes "<name>: <count> item(s)", which proves singular and plural.

Square state follows `count` and `needs_person`, and the tag tone follows `needs_person` only. Verify: in the component test, a station with `needs_person: true, count: 0` has the needs-person class and ", needs a person" in its text; `count: 3, needs_person: false` has the work class and a visible "3"; `count: 0, needs_person: false` has the empty class and no numeral. Pre-sale's tag reads exactly "1 WAITING" with `psl-tag--person`, and Closing's reads "ON TRACK" with `psl-tag--neutral`. A fixture `note` of "all good" renders as "all good", unparsed and not re-cased.
The coverage time shows. Verify: the component test finds "FACTORY FLOOR · UPDATED 14 Nov 16:40 WAT" and a `<time dateTime="2026-11-14T15:40:00Z">`.

Empty lines. Verify: with cookie `psl_mock_overview=empty`, e2e at 1440 shows four 0 tiles, "No lines to show yet.", no `radiogroup` "View" and the "See all exceptions" link. The component test covers the same with `lines: []`.
All-zero lines. Verify: with `psl_mock_overview=zero` (e2e) or `zero.json` (component), all squares are empty-styled, no numerals are shown and tags appear verbatim.

Wrong user: a person without `overview` never fetches E-OVERVIEW. Verify: a component test with the `me.pm.json` fixture shows "This section isn't open to your role." with a link to `/my-work`, and `fetch` was never called with `/api/v1/overview`. `e2e/frame.spec.ts:108` still passes unchanged.

401, 403 and 404 from E-OVERVIEW. Verify: in the component test, 401 renders "You're signed out." with a sign-in link whose `next` is `/overview`. 403 and 404 each render "The factory floor isn't open to your role." plus the server message and no tiles. After each, advancing fake timers 30 s makes no further overview request. In e2e, `page.route('**/api/v1/overview', …)` fulfils 403 with the mock's 403 body (a scenario cookie would also hit `/me`). The page shows the not-open text with no axe violations.

Provider failure, no stale figures. Verify: in the component test, the first load succeeds, then the 15 s poll gets a 500 (or a rejected fetch). The page shows `role="alert"` with "We couldn't load the factory floor. Your work is safe; nothing was changed.", "Last loaded 14 Nov 16:40 WAT." and "Reference <code> for support.", and **no** totals `<dl>` or Lines section. Try again with a 200 restores the figures.

Polling follows visibility. Verify: with fake timers in the component test, there is a second request at 15 000 ms and none before. With `document.visibilityState` stubbed to `hidden` and `visibilitychange` dispatched, no request happens over 60 s. Back to `visible` after more than 15 s triggers one immediate request. There is never more than one request in flight: a slow response plus a tick gives one request.
Out-of-order responses never win. Verify: in the component test, poll A is slow and poll B fast with a later `as_of`. After both resolve, B's figures and time show.

Exceptions place. No request to `/api/v1/exceptions` is made. Tests do not navigate the link. `grep -rn "features/exceptions" frontend/src/features/overview frontend/src/app/overview` prints nothing.

Layouts and accessibility at 390px and 1440px (A-ACCESSIBILITY). Verify: e2e at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844 for the default flat view, and at 1440 for 3D. Keyboard: Tab reaches "Flat" and "3D floor", arrow keys move the selection, and the focus outline is 2px solid. The "See all exceptions" link is reachable.

risk.rationale: I rated it medium: - The page is read-only and shows no money or identity data. - It adds the first runtime npm dependency since the app frame: `three`, pinned exactly, with `@types/three` as a devDependency, in frontend/package.json and the lockfile. That needs a client-only dynamic import, a WebGL and reduced-motion fallback, and care with bundle weight. That is the `dependency` surface. - It shares the `M1_OPERATIONS` seam (server.mjs:24, tests/mock-contract.test.ts:69-76) with three parallel lanes. - It shows factory-wide counts. These must come from E-OVERVIEW as returned (INV-ACCESS), never be computed in the browser, and always show their `as_of` time. Surfaces are `ui` (SCR-06 on desktop and phone) and `dependency` (three). Moving SCR-12 out removes `payments`. There is no `api` or `contract-change`, because it reads one existing GET and changes nothing in schema.d.ts or openapi.json. There is no `security` or `auth`, because gating comes from `/me` destinations and the backend.

findings.summary: `frontend/package-lock.json` adds `"peer": true` to `node_modules/eslint-plugin-import` (hunk at about line 3913). This is npm-version metadata, not three or one of its dependencies. The brief expects a lockfile change limited to three and its deps. It is harmless and `npm ci` passes, but ideally revert that one line.

3D floor: token cubes collide with each other and with the count sprite at busy stations (visible at 1440 on Invoices, Pre-sale and Planning). Expected: tokens sit clear of the sprite and the neighbouring block. Actual: the two-row token grid (`frontend/src/features/floor/scene.ts:140-143`) runs into the sprite placed at `scene.ts:135` and the adjacent block. The sprite text stays legible at 2x.

Tag tones and line identity differ from the approved SCR-06 artboard. The artboard shows ON TRACK in green, WAITING in amber, STOPPED and UNCERTAIN in red, and an avatar and subtitle per line (e.g. "RFP · commercial"). The build draws every tag neutral (ON TRACK, the 2 PROBLEMS in the zero variant) or in the signal tint (WAITING, STOPPED, UNCERTAIN, 2 PROBLEMS), and omits avatars and subtitles, because E-OVERVIEW has no fields for them. This follows the recorded PMO-0-4 decision (spec.md lines 84, 91; readiness.md line 25), which is flagged for product acceptance. Expected: product confirms or supplies the tone rule before merge. Actual: as described, in `frontend/src/features/overview/OverviewPage.tsx` (`LineRows`, the `psl-tag` class choice). If product does not accept the recorded decision, this becomes blocking.
